# coval_run_template (Resource)

Manages a reusable Coval run template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coval_run_template" "regression" {
  display_name = "Support Regression"
  description  = "Runs the support regression suite against the production configuration."

  agent_ids    = [coval_agent.support.id]
  persona_ids  = [coval_persona.customer.id]
  test_set_ids = [coval_test_set.regression.id]
  metric_ids   = [coval_metric.resolution.id]

  iteration_count = 3
  concurrency     = 5

  metadata = {
    owner = "support"
  }

  tags = ["regression", "support"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_ids` (Set of String) Agent IDs included in the template. Every agent must exist and be accessible.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable run-template name.
- `persona_ids` (Set of String) Persona IDs included in the template. Every persona must exist.
- `test_set_ids` (Set of String) Test-set IDs included in the template. Every test set must exist.

### Optional

- `concurrency` (Number) Maximum number of simulations to run concurrently.
- `description` (String) Run-template description.
- `iteration_count` (Number) Number of times to run each test case.
- `metadata` (Dynamic) Arbitrary JSON object containing run-template metadata. Set {} to clear it.
- `metric_ids` (Set of String) Metric IDs evaluated by the template. Set [] to use the agents' default metrics.
- `mutation_ids` (Set of String) Mutation IDs used for A/B testing. Set [] to clear them.
- `sub_sample_seed` (Number) Random seed for reproducible sub-sampling. Omit it to let Coval choose the sample.
- `sub_sample_size` (Number) Number of test cases to sample randomly. Use 0 to include every test case.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags associated with the run template. Set [] to clear them.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID that owns this resource. Omit it to use the organization's active default workspace.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `created_by_user_id` (String) ID of the user who created the run template when available.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned run-template ID.
- `name` (String) Canonical API resource name.
- `update_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the latest update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = coval_run_template.regression
  identity = {
    id = "abc123def456ghi789jklm"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String)

#### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String)

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coval_run_template.regression abc123def456ghi789jklm
```
